subject: Object-view
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1019a). The general format, rendered from the canonical PDF (printed page 134): `identifier-1 AS { [FACTORY OF] object-class-name-1 [ONLY] | interface-name-1 | UNIVERSAL }`, one brace, AS/FACTORY/ONLY/UNIVERSAL underlined, OF not. Grammar `objectView : objectReferenceTerm objectViewPhrase+`, `objectViewPhrase : AS UNIVERSAL | AS (FACTORY OF?)? className ONLY?` (interface-name and class-name are one word; the binder refuses FACTORY/ONLY on an interface, COBOL2872). UNIVERSAL is a new token, 8.9-reserved 2002+ (cobol-words.json). The view is an object-reference ATOM, reached by every object-reference position (INVOKE receiver, inline receiver, SET Format 5 sender, RAISE). Was COBOL0901 on AS in every position. [editions: the OO facility, 2002+]
